name: Iris out
summary: Classic cartoon iris: a black frame closes to a small circle at a point, holds, then goes fully black.

params.name: x
params.note: point the iris closes on, x in px

params.name: y
params.note: point the iris closes on, y in px

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: len
params.note: frames the iris takes to close

params.name: hold
params.note: frames the small circle holds before going black

author: krakujs
